parsed.notes: The filing names the two financial covenants but gives no actual values or numeric thresholds. It states only that the company was in compliance with all financial covenants as of July 31, 2026. The August 15, 2025 First Amendment changed the minimum Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio for certain measurement periods and excluded certain fiscal 2026 cash taxes from that ratio, but the amended levels are not disclosed. The leverage ratio is also used to set the interest margin; it is included here only because it is a stated maximum covenant.
